description: The full manual of this bridge: every verb, the ladder for a control that refuses a value, forms in one call, the fast `raw` route, widget verdicts, recipes and suites, mocks, native dialogs, isolated logins, reports, tabs and sign-in. The instructions you received at connect are the short version, and some clients cut even those. Call this when you are not sure which verb fits, or before a long form-heavy or multi-login task. Pass `topic` (a word such as "form", "recipe", "mock", "dialog", "sign", "tab", "widget", "screenshot") to get only the paragraphs that mention it. Free and read-only.
